entities.summary: Anaïs Napoleón was a French-Spanish photographer. She was one of the first women who made daguerreotypes in Spain. She was also a specialist in making business cards that included photographs. Napoleon was always very interested in learning about photographic advances and applied them to her work. Some evidence suggests that she was the only woman working with moving images.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anaïs Napoleón was a French-Spanish photographer. She was one of the first women who made daguerreotypes in Spain. She was also a specialist in making business cards that included photographs. Napoleon was always very interested in learning about photographic advances and applied them to her work. Some evidence suggests that she was the only woman working with moving images.
